live_validation.result: ready=true; docker/compose/plugin/retrieval pass; provider and channel credentials skip (none configured); documents not_applicable

not_verified: Exactly-once WebSocket delivery over a live remote transport: the mock and unit path prove the stable client_seq and acknowledgement contract, but no real remote WebSocket server was exercised.
Live model generation: no provider credentials were configured, so generation receipts were exercised through the deterministic path only.

extra_debugging: Crash injection: SIGKILL at every boundary inside the action-effect transaction. All three kill points left zero events, unchanged state, and no orphan claims; only the clean run committed.
Migration replay: a database built at migration 0005 with legacy scene rows migrates forward through all 26, preserves the scene and its system_state, and re-runs apply nothing.
Concurrency: 8 processes claiming the same native message produced one turn and one shared turn id.
Mutation checks: making a model-proposed DC authoritative and removing ingress dedup were each caught by three independent tests.
Fuzzing: ~15000 hostile inputs across the GM command, GM mutation, proposal, and setup parsers leak no unexpected exception.
defects_found_and_fixed: Two live validation probes raised NameError on every run, reported as honest failures that hid a code defect behind an environment result.
A scalar where a manifest list belongs raised a raw TypeError, so the CLI showed a traceback instead of an actionable message.
A stale campaign selection file is shared across every database in its directory and was trusted blindly, making every command fail with a confusing 'not found'.
